name: Birnin Kebbi

queries.query: Birnin Kebbi Nigeria official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry Kebbi surveyor general
queries.result: Found the first-party Kebbi Geographic Information Services (KEBGIS) agency site, the Kebbi State government e-services page linking KEBGIS, and the federal Office of the Surveyor-General cadastral-services page. KEBGIS evidences state land registration and geospatial administration, but no anonymous parcel-vector endpoint was exposed.

queries.query: Birnin Kebbi Najeriya taswirar kadastara fili rajistar ƙasa Kebbi hukuma
queries.result: The first-party search surfaced the same KEBGIS and Kebbi State government land-administration sources; no Hausa-language public parcel map/API or anonymous parcel geometry response was identified.

officialSources.evidence: First-party agency site describes KEBGIS as the Kebbi State government geospatial/land-management agency, with land registration, digital Certificate of Occupancy, property-document verification, and geospatial products. The page links its application host but does not expose public parcel features.

First-party About page names the Kebbi GIS agency and describes a digital land registry, land registration guidance, and land-administration scope for Kebbi State. This is local/state custodian evidence, not evidence of an open parcel-vector API.
Official state e-services page lists KEBBI GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION SYSTEM (KEBGIS) under land administration and links to the KEBGIS website.

officialSources.operator: Office of the Surveyor-General of the Federation
officialSources.evidence: Federal first-party page describes national cadastral/legal survey and cadastral GIS functions. It is general national agency evidence, not a Birnin Kebbi or Kebbi State parcel service.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local/state custodian and land-registration procedure/service evidence only; Birnin Kebbi parcel geometry coverage was not verified.
coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: No point query was possible because no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was identified. This is not evidence of parcel absence or citywide absence.
